{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any column that might contain test order indicators
# Look for 'test' in any column, case-insensitive

# First, inspect all columns for any value containing 'test'
test_indicators = []
for col in df.columns:
    matches = df[col].astype(str).str.contains('test', case=False, na=False)
    if matches.any():
        test_indicators.append(col)
        print(f"Column '{col}' contains 'test' in some values: {df[col][matches].unique()}")

if not test_indicators:
    print("No column contains 'test' in any value.")"}
